bone

components · 0.2.0 · v4 round 10 · aj-c-bone

The skeleton's piece: the shape of something still to come (a line of words, a box, a dot, a memo's waveform), in --bone with one shimmer band shared by every bone on the screen. Every loading page draws its skeleton from it, inside its real frame.
